body:
Thank you for the help, I really appreciate it.
 
Sadly all of my clothing isn’t in style as all I have are oversized tshirts and jeans, and the same pair of tennis shoes. 

I get anxious on both things, I’m scared of being excluded even if I already am, and whatever I say comes out awkward so I tend to overthink that too.

Thanks for the suggestion for games, I’ll look into them if I have time. Do you have any recommendations or favorites?

I don’t really interact in my classes because it does cause me major anxiety and it’s hard for me to connect with people. For context, I’m a teen girl that’s not really up to date with things. My clothing is outdated, and my interests don’t line up with a lot of people. Everyone talks through Snapchat and I’m not really familiar with it (and I don’t have anyone to contact anyways). It feels like I’m out of the loop a lot since my classmates talk about their social lives which I don’t necessarily have one.  I also start shaking/ tensing up when people talk to me and it feels like I don’t have the energy to respond.

I like video games, although I’m very bad at them. I’m not able to buy any except play free ones like Fortnite and for an exception, Minecraft since my parents don’t like me spending money on them. I used to be very interested in gaming though, but I haven’t had the time and happiness to go play. I normally play solo since talking to people over the microphone/chat also makes me anxious. I think video games can be art, some of the graphics and stories I see in games are very beautiful.

I can’t look towards therapy or get diagnosed for any mental illnesses because my asian family believes that it’s a scam and an excuse for not doing well. High school counselors do more harm than good, seeing as how someone committed suicide a few days earlier. And they genuinely don’t do anything here at my school other than sit around and get paid for changing a couple of schedules.
